findings.category: OLBG vs official league start-time & neutral-venue discrepancies
findings.detail: OLBG lists NBA tip-offs 10 minutes after official `nba.com` schedule times (`CLE@PHI` 23:10Z vs 23:00Z, `DEN@OKC` 01:40Z vs 01:30Z, `HOU@SAS` 01:40Z vs 01:30Z — approximate national TV tip vs scheduled tip). Additionally, `HOU Rockets @ SA Spurs` is played at neutral Moody Center (Austin, TX) and `Maccabi Tel Aviv vs Real Madrid` is played at neutral Aleksandar Nikolic Hall (Belgrade), where OLBG provides no neutral-court flag.
findings.official_source: NBA.com official game page & EuroLeague API (`api-live.euroleague.net`)
findings.resolution: Anchored `start_utc` to official league timestamps and applied 0-pt neutral-court home advantage on both fixtures.
